title: Investigate OpenRouter Chinese open-weight and regime-diverse provider surface
boundedObjective: Reopen the V4 matrix campaign to evaluate Chinese open-weight families and materially distinct training/process regimes for the OpenRouter control lane, then decide whether the wave-1 control panel should pivot from Claude-on-OpenRouter to a different family design.
notes: R04 replaced the old OpenRouter placeholder with a Qwen-centered Chinese open-weight control policy.
